messages:
emily: Storage alert: background scrub on eunorth1 flashpack-3 found a cluster of small-block CRC mismatches and triggered local eviction on 12 nodes. Seeing gpu-attach errors for jobs that depended on local scratch. dash: https://dash.redwood.internal/storage/eunorth1 :warning:
ops-bot: ALERT storage_crc_mismatch cluster=eunorth1 nodes=12 affected_disks=12 severity=medium iops_drop=28%
vince: summary from sample node gnode-en1-212: `scrubber: checksum_mismatch blk=0x9fa3` then `evict: stale-extent` and rapid reclaims. attach failures show `failed to mount /scratch: no such file` during pod start.
celine: these nodes got firmware 1.4.2 two weeks ago (flashpack-3 cohort). Noting correlation but scrub hit window is 04:07 UTC when janitor overlap increased IO.
emily: ops telemetry shows no AC spike or PDU anomaly in that rack. so environmental causes unlikely. could be wear-induced bitrot surfaced by aggressive deep scrubs.
vince: deeper logs: `nvme0n1: media_error lba=0x9fa3 count=8` and SMART shows rising reallocated sector counts on 5 of the 12.
storage-bot: SMART-ALERT nodes=[gnode-en1-197,gnode-en1-203,gnode-en1-212] reallocated_sectors=[12,9,15] temp_avg=67C
celine: impact: gpu attach queue latency for eunorth1 dedicated pool up ~1.8x; scheduler is failing ~3% of attempts on first try leading to retries and backpressure.
emily: proposed mitigations: 1) pause deep-scrub on non-critical nodes to reduce read amplification 2) cordon and migrate pods off the 12 most-impacted nodes (drain preemptible first) 3) run targeted SMART snapshot + ddrescue on suspected disks and handoff to vendor 4) decide whether to progressively retire nodes with reallocated sectors >10.
vince: downside: pausing scrubs delays catching other latent corruption. tradeoff is more immediate attach/backoff affecting customer SLOs vs. longer-term data integrity. we need to document risk and timeline.
celine: cost note: to keep SLOs we can spin up ~60 vGPUs in eu-west2 for 6h, estimated cost ~$1.8k (compute) plus ~$250 potential inter-region egress for scratch syncs. Approve?
emily: approve for critical clusters only. prioritize dedicated pools and jobs with high SLAs.
ops-bot: OP-5517 created for on-site diag and vendor handoff; tech ETA ~50m
vince: running cordon on initial 6 nodes: `./tools/cordon_nodes.sh --file nodes_eunorth1_crc_batch1.txt --batch 3`
storage-bot: collector job queued: `collect-smart --nodes nodes_eunorth1_crc_batch1.txt --out /inc/INC-2026-362/smart/` job_id=6721
celine: also enabling low-priority throttling on janitor: `janitorctl set-scrub-rate --cluster eunorth1 --rate 0.4` to cut background IO by ~60% temporarily. ops, alert if PDU temps rise.
emily: opening incident INC-2026-362 and drafting comms for Dedicated customers (short note + follow-up postmortem promise). if vendor confirms media issues we'll prepare small retirement batch and capacity compensation plan.
vince: vendor call scheduled in 30m. will share call notes and recommended disk RMA lists here.
emily: thanks all. brief updates only in this thread unless call needs immediate escalation. :white_check_mark:
